text.p: Betar Jerusalem became Israeli soccer champions for the third time in their history on Saturday by after drawing 1-1 with Hapoel Jerusalem.

As their nearest challengers dropped points in the weekend's National League action, Betar took an unassailable eight-point lead with just two rounds to play. Nearest pursuers Hapoel Petah Tikva and Hapoel Beersheba, lost and drew respectively.

Hapoel Ashkelon clinched the second division championship on Friday and with it a place in next season's National League. The second promotion spot will go either to Ironi Ashdod or Maccabi Netanya when the Second Division completes its season next weekend.
